3 AI video generators you can try without a subscription, with the actual trade-offs. Dreamina Seedance 2.0 gives free daily credits; watermark/export rules vary by plan, model and settings. Google Flow gives 50 credits/day; Veo 3.1 Lite costs 10 per generation, so about five clips if access is available. Free generation may be unavailable at peak hours, credits do not roll over, and free accounts cannot upscale to 1080p. Wan2.2 has no hosted-service credit cap when self-hosted, but its 5B model targets a 24 GB GPU and hardware/electricity are not free.
Checked October 10, 2026; limits can change.

repo-whistle-01:youtube.text:
Whistle by Cactus Compute is an open speech-to-text model with a 16.9 MB file and a local CPU runtime shared with Needle. It takes 16 kHz mono audio, up to 30 seconds per call, and supports English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch and Polish. The browser sandbox runs on-device after the initial model download. Word timestamps and keyword biasing are supported. Author-published benchmarks show wins and losses versus Whisper base; this video does not claim a universal speed or accuracy win.
Sources: https://cactuscompute.com/blog/whistle and https://github.com/cactus-compute/needle
Our actual browser demo misheard Claude as Cloud; inspect important names. The sandbox run is not a native M4 Pro performance test.

Credits: Own capture and demo using the Whistle browser sandbox; documentation and engine by Cactus Compute (Apache-2.0). Published benchmark claims belong to the authors.

Pomelli is Google Labs' AI marketing experiment. Photoshoot turns a product image into brand-aware studio/lifestyle variations using Business DNA, and lets you edit/download results. Agent features also support brand books and websites. Google describes it as free; regional/language availability and experiment limits apply. AI may alter your actual product, so check labels, proportions, colors and claims before using an output commercially. This is a current tool spotlight, not a claim of an October launch.
Official sources: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-labs/pomelli-photoshoot/ and https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-labs/pomelli-agentic-capabilities/
